label: Q44 ancestor source-supply controls, checked (inference)
rule: Causal-chain induction, explicit reception argument and equality elimination
meaning: Seven finite controls distinguish participant actuality, represented distinction, causal composition, the unreceived-to-OwnBeing step, qualification of the selected witness and uniqueness, and a positive composition case. The common-ancestor property is witnessed with explicit nonempty chains, not assumed to equal a causal edge. The models test formal interfaces and do not provide evidence against the interpreted metaphysical premises or certify rival worldviews.
